summary: This directory manages the ingestion and structural conversion of XML content. Its primary architectural purpose is to bridge the gap between raw XML data formats and the internal object models required by the application, ensuring consistent data availability for downstream processing.
responsibilities: Parsing raw XML input into machine-readable structures
Mapping XML elements to defined domain objects
relationships: The XML parser processes raw strings to output structured objects.
Structured objects represent the final output produced by the data transformation process.
designDecisions: Encapsulation of parsing logic within a dedicated module
Transformation of parsed XML content into structured object formats
